verdict.rationale: Dagster documents some bulk-style operations — wiping/deleting dynamic partitions 'in a single action' across multi-partitioned assets, and running 'subsets' of dbt models/assets in one command — and the Dagster+ MCP server lets an AI session 'take actions' in a deployment. However, there's no explicit documentation of bulk asset materialization APIs, batch job/run management, or AI-driven bulk operation examples beyond partition wiping. missing for 10: explicit bulk API/GraphQL batch mutation docs, AI-agent examples of operating on many assets/runs simultaneously, independent confirmation of scale.
